title: Design and performance evaluation of UCX for the Tofu Interconnect D on Fugaku towards efficient multithreaded communication
version: Journal of Supercomputing 80, pp. 20715–20742; version of record with 13 August 2024 correction

passages.note: University of Tsukuba and RIKEN researchers tested communication on installed TofuD hardware. For their multiple-worker UCX implementation, they report about 1.7 microseconds for a four-byte message with 24 threads, six interfaces and four completion queues with zero-copy optimization. The tests do not include Tofu2.
